summary: Six Rivers National Forest lookout in Humboldt County; the register dates it 1979, but a 2008 FFLA report says a new lookout opened that year.

staffing.note: A North Coast Journal feature (undated in the copy read) calls it the only fully staffed lookout in Humboldt County, June through mid-October, and in the same article lists it among lookouts staffed only in extreme fire danger.

access.note: A North Coast Journal feature, undated in the copy read, says it welcomes visitors and is easily reached from Friday Ridge Road southeast of Willow Creek.

events.note: Build year given by the register; the register describes no design
FFLA Western Region report says a brand new lookout was completed and opened on Brush Mountain that year; does not match the 1979 register date
Registered June 9, 2017 as US 1206, CA 122; nominated by Jason Barnes

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register (1979) and the 2008 FFLA Western Region report (a brand new lookout completed and opened on Brush Mt.) disagree on the build date, and the report does not say whether it replaced an earlier cab. Left unresolved, so not in resolved_conflicts. The North Coast Journal feature is undated in the cached copy and contradicts itself on staffing (fully staffed June to mid-October versus staffed only in extreme fire danger). Staffing is recorded in facts as disputed, not resolved. The access level public rests on that feature alone; worth confirming with the Six Rivers National Forest. Record elevation 1226.2 m matches the register. Not used: a peakbagging.com search snippet giving 3,988 ft (not read). Not checked: Six Rivers NF pages and any recent closure notices. No new photos. Budget: four page reads (register, 2008 report, Forest Lookouts page, OpenStreetMap) plus one feature read and one search.
